paite: Huan Isak in Jakob asam a, avualzawl a, thu leng apia a akiang ah, "Kanaan gam nungakte lak a mi zi in na nei ding ahi kei.
english: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

paite: Thou inla, Padan-aram gam a na nu pa Bethuel inn ah hoh inla, huai a kipan na nu sanggampa Laban tanute lak a mi zi in va nei in.
english: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

paite: Pathian Bangkim hihthei in hon vualzawl in, mipi tampite na hong hihtheihna ding in chi tampi hon suangsak in, hon pungsak hen.
english: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,

paite: Mikhual na hihna gam, Pathian in Abraham kiang a apiak na luahna ding in Abraham vualzawlna leng hon tangsak hen, nang leh na suante leng," achi hi.
english: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”

paite: Huchi in Isak in Jakob asawlkhia hi. Huan ama'n Padan-aram gam a, Jakob leh Esau nu Rebekah sanggampa Siria mi Bethuel tapa, Laban kiang azuanta hi.
english: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

paite: Esau in, Isak in Jakob avualzawl a zi nei ding in Padan-aram gam ah asawlkhia, chih leh avualzawl lai a, Kanaan gam nungakte lak a mi zi in na nei ding ahi kei,
heading: Esau In Zi Dang Anei
english: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”

paite: chi in thu apia chih leh Jakob in anu leh apa thu mang in Padan-aram gam ah apaita chih athei hi.
english: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.

paite: Esau in Kanaan gam nungakte'n apa Isak lung ahihkim kei uh chih athei hi.
english: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

paite: Ishmael kiang ah Esau ava hoh a, Abraham tapa Ishmael tanu, Nebajoth sanggamnu Mahalath, zi in anei a, zi aneihsate ban ah amah aneih behlap ahi.
english: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

paite: Beer-sheba a kipan Jakob apawt a, Haran kholam azuanta hi.
heading: Bethel A Jakob Mang
english: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

paite: Koi lai mun hiam atung a, ni atum tak ziak in huai ah agiakta hi. Huai ah suang khat ala a; lukham in anei a, huai ah ihmu ding in alumta hi.
english: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

paite: Mang anei a, ngai in, leitung ah lei ahong kidoh a, adawn in van asun hi. Ngai in, atung ah Pathian angelte kahtou in akumsuk uhi.
english: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

paite: Ngai in, adawn ah TOUPA adingh a, "Kei TOUPA, na pu Abraham' Pathian leh Isak' Pathian ka hi. Na lupna gam nang leh na suante kiang ah ka hon pe ding.
english: Behold, Yahweh stood above it, and said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.

paite: Na suante lei a leivui zah a tam ahi ding ua, tumlam, suahlam, mallam leh simlam ah na dalhzak ding uh. Nang ah leh na suan ah leitung a inkuan chih vualzawl in a-om ding uh.
english: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.

paite: Ngai in, na kiang ah ka om, na paina peuh ah ka hon veng ding a, hiai gam ah ka hon pikik nawn ding. Na kiang a ka gen ka hih masak keileh ka hon nuse kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

paite: Jakob ihmu ahong khanglou a, "Hiai mun ah TOUPA a-om ngeingei hi. Ke'n lah ka na thei kei a,” achi hi.
english: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

paite: Huchi in alau a, "Hiai mun lauhuai hi na mai e! Hiai mun dang hilou in, Pathian inn na hi ei ve, hiai van kongpi na hi ei ve,” achi hi.
english: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

paite: Zingkhang in Jakob athou a, asuang lukham ala a, suangphuh in aphut a, adawn ah sathau abuak hi.
english: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.

paite: Huai mun min Bethel asa a; akho min bel atung in Luz ahi.
english: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

paite: Jakob in, "Pathian ka kiang a om a, ka paina lampi a ahon ven a, nek ding tanghou leh silh ding puansilh TOUPA'N ahon piak a,
english: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,

paite: ka pa inn a lungmuangtak a ka hong pai nawnleh TOUPA, ka Pathian ahi ding a,
english: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and Yahweh will be my God,

paite: hiai suang ka phuh leng Pathian' inn ahi ding a; ka kiang a na hon piak ding tengteng a kipan sawm-a-khat ka hon pe ngeingei ding," chi in akichiamta hi.
english: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”
